title: Leanne Morgan - The Time Of Our Lives Tour
seo_title: Leanne Morgan Comedy Tour in Springfield, MO – Nov 22
description: Leanne Morgan brings her stand-up comedy show, The Time of Our Lives Tour, to Great Southern Bank Arena, following her Netflix special I'm Every Woman and sold-out shows across the United States. It takes place Sunday, November 22, 2026 at 7:00 PM at 901 S. National Ave. in Springfield, MO, with doors opening at 5:30 PM. Parking is $20, and premium parking is $50.
